segments.text: "Welcome to Robotics Today, your daily dose of the latest news and updates from the world of robotics.
July 27th, 2026 - we've got six stories that'll get your week off to a great start.
From breakthroughs in humanoid robots to advancements in simulation tools."
From Planet ROS, "ROS Discourse General: Dual Safe/Hostile physics gate for robot claims — Safe must allow, Hostile must refuse".
A small Dual physics gate has been built to test robot claims using a boolean gate developed in Rust.
The gate is designed so that the "Safe" path allows a claim while the "Hostile" path refuses it.
A production-ready version of the gate has been created and can be cloned and run, generating sealed receipts for validation purposes.
This milestone marks an important development in testing robot claims, enabling more robust and secure evaluation processes.
From Humanoids Daily, "A Golden Milestone: Figure Manufactures Its 1,000th Figure 03 Humanoid".
Figure has officially manufactured its 1,000th Figure 03 humanoid robot at its BotQ facility, marking a significant acceleration in production.
The milestone comes roughly three months after the company announced scaling its throughput to one robot per hour.
This achievement solidifies Figure's position as one of the few Western companies capable of moving beyond bespoke prototyping into legitimate batch manufacturing.
According to reports, the increased production capacity was made possible through the implementation of advanced automation systems and process optimization techniques at the facility.
The company's ability to achieve this milestone demonstrates a substantial leap forward in its technology and manufacturing capabilities.
This notable accomplishment will likely be closely watched by industry experts as Figure continues to expand its operations and explore new frontiers in humanoid robotics.
From Planet ROS, "ROS Discourse General: [Release] Gazebo ROS Text-to-Speech (TTS) Plugin – From Gazebo Classic to Gazebo Harmonic".
An open-source Text-to-Speech plugin for Gazebo Harmonic has been released, supporting both Gazebo Classic and modern versions with ROS 2 Humble and Jazzy.
The plugin was redesigned from the original Gazebo Classic version and is now available on GitHub as gz_ros_tts.
It has undergone successful testing on various robots and environments, including the Heinz H1 Humanoid Robot, demonstrating its capabilities in real-world scenarios.
This new plugin aims to improve the integration of artificial intelligence and robotics in simulation environments.
The development process involved a thorough overhaul of the original codebase, ensuring seamless compatibility with Gazebo Harmonic's latest features.
The redesigned plugin has been thoroughly tested for stability and functionality, allowing users to deploy it on their own projects without major concerns.
The successful testing results confirm that the plugin is ready for adoption by developers and researchers seeking to enhance their simulation environments.
The release of this new Text-to-Speech plugin marks an important milestone in the integration of AI technologies into robotics simulation software.

As this technology continues to advance, users can expect further improvements and refinements, enabling more sophisticated applications in areas such as natural language processing and autonomous systems.
From The Robot Report, "Magmotor makes motors for a changing world for 150+ years".
Magmotor Technologies Inc. has announced plans to expand its operations, with the goal of tripling its income and number of employees over the next few years.
This expansion is part of the company's ongoing efforts to adapt to a rapidly evolving industry.
The expansion was made possible through a strategic investment and the implementation of new manufacturing technologies.

Magmotor's expertise lies in producing custom AC and DC fan motors, particularly brush motors, which are still in high demand despite many other companies having converted to brushless motors due to legacy items requiring these traditional motors.
The company has been in operation for over 150 years, demonstrating its ability to adapt to changing market conditions.
This expansion highlights Magmotor's commitment to staying ahead of the curve and meeting the needs of industries that continue to rely on traditional motor technologies.
From Humanoids Daily, "Generative Bionics Unveils GENE.01: A Smart-Skin Humanoid Built on Peer-Reviewed Ergonomics."

Generative Bionics has launched GENE.01, a multimodal smart-skin humanoid platform that incorporates distributed tactile skin sensing touch, force, temperature, and proximity for safe physical interaction with human workers.
The company built the platform in six months after an $81 million seed raise, utilizing physics-native AI to co-optimize physical hardware and motor control around human ergonomic safety.
GENE.01's development was facilitated by a peer-reviewed approach, ensuring the robot's design and functionality meet rigorous scientific standards.
The platform's digital twin is now being made open-source across various repositories, including PyPI, Conda, and ROS ecosystem repositories.
This move paves the way for the wider adoption of advanced humanoid robots in industries that require human worker safety and efficiency.
From Humanoids Daily, "Highline Commerce Taps Ultra Robotics to Automate 30% of Fulfillment in Brooklyn Hub,"
a partnership has been formed between Highline Commerce and Ultra Robotics to automate up to 30% of its order volume at Industry City tech hub in Brooklyn.

The humanoid robots, designed for continuous operation without battery swaps or tipping risks, are handling pick, pack, scan, and conveyor processes for over 200 retail brands, marking one of the first commercial deployments of such technology.
The robots utilize a combination of AI and machine learning algorithms to optimize the order fulfillment process, allowing for faster and more accurate processing.
Highline Commerce has implemented this system in its Brooklyn hub, which will now operate at increased efficiency, with the potential to expand to other locations in the future.
The automation process was made possible through a collaboration between both companies' experts.
This partnership is significant as it showcases the growing adoption of humanoid robots in commercial retail operations, marking an important step forward for the AI and tech industry.
"It's time to shut down the circuitry for today!
Thanks for tuning in to our daily dose of robotics goodness.
From dual-safe physics gates to robots with a mind of their own, we've got the tech that's making us rethink the future - and it's been a wild ride!"
